title: Astro Portal session event payload: guided_evening
description: A guided evening that ran under the session's night ended (« Terminer la soirée », or closed the morning after): its route, the way of observing, the help of « Pointage avancé » chosen, the steps seen out of the route's steps, its start and end, and whether « Pour les enfants » was on. Written once by the application, at the evening's end, only when the evening ran under the night's execution (the pointing aid, a mount, the share); an evening to the naked eye, with binoculars or on a tripod without aid writes nothing and stays on the phone (its Journal card). Versioned by `version`: a reader keeps what it knows and ignores the rest; a reader that does not know the type shows it as an ordinary report. Nothing personal: no place, no name. See session-events.md.

version.description: The payload's version (1). A later version may add fields; a reader of version 1 reads the fields below and ignores the others only where `additionalProperties` allows it (it does not here: a version 2 is a new schema).

title.description: The route's title as the application showed it, in the observer's language (« Les dix étoiles les plus brillantes »).

mode.description: The way of observing (`observingModes` of the routes).

help.description: The help of « Pointage avancé »: none, « Aide au pointage » (a tripod), « Affinage du GoTo » (a mount).

stepsSeen.description: The steps the observer moved past with « Étape suivante ».

durationMinutes.description: From the start to the end, in whole minutes.

kids.description: « Pour les enfants » was on at some point of the evening.
